fichas.title: Fire protection of slabs and ceilings
fichas.summary: Fire-protection guidance for ceilings, floor slabs, cellar slabs, openings, and common slab and ceiling constructions. Required fire resistance depends on the construction and applicable building regulations; openings requiring fire resistance need corresponding fire-protection closures. The page reproduces an excerpt of classified slab thicknesses from DIN 4102.
uses: Fire protection of floor and ceiling assemblies
Protection of openings through slabs and ceilings

fichas.title: Fire protection requirements for roofs
fichas.summary: Roofing is generally required to have hard covering and resist airborne fire spread and radiated heat. Roof overhangs, cornices, projections, rooflights, and transparent roofing require minimum spacing from fire compartment walls. For certain buildings in rows, projecting roofs and components within a stated safety distance must have fire resistance matching the connected building component’s slabs; exceptions are noted for building classes 1–3 and partial roof areas.
uses: Fire protection of roof projections and adjoining buildings

dimensions.label: Safety distance
dimensions.context: Distance applying to loadbearing and bracing components of certain projecting roofs or building components; the stated distance is within the fire-protection requirements for buildings in rows.
